item: Every face film of a copper node passes the half copper layer (h_eff = 1/(1/h + t_cu/(2 k_cu))), and the contact link and exposed film of a metal block pass the half block
why: The layered models keep the column mean of each copper layer, so the flux of every ambient film starts half a layer below the face; the series film moves the FVM, FDM, Lumped and Analytic records by about 2e-5 K (copper, 5e-7 of the rise) and finned-block boards by up to 0.04 K; the 3D solid already resolved the slab and does not move. This file holds the FINAL numbers of every record it lists, including the records that the earlier pending files (drawn-copper-faces, lumped-first-link-edge, block-exact-cover) also moved: those records were taken out of the older files so that each record is in one file.
